neighbourhoods.name: Whitwick

neighbourhoods.name: Ashby-de-la-Zouch

neighbourhoods.name: Ibstock

neighbourhoods.name: Measham

housing: North West Leicestershire grew around coal mining, and Coalville, Whitwick, Ibstock and Measham still have rows of brick terraces alongside post-war council estates. Ashby-de-la-Zouch has Georgian and Victorian houses at its centre, and large new-build estates have been added around Ashby, Coalville and Castle Donington. Jobs at East Midlands Airport and the logistics parks bring demand for rented homes around Castle Donington and Kegworth.
checkinTips: Mining-era terraces in Coalville, Whitwick and Ibstock: photograph damp at the base of walls, back yards and outbuildings.
New-build estates around Ashby, Coalville and Castle Donington: record snagging marks, sealant and the state of turf, fences and parking spaces.
Period houses in Ashby town centre: photograph sash windows, old doors, cellars and any chimney breasts.
Homes near East Midlands Airport and the logistics parks: note window and door seals and any trickle vents, which matter for noise.
Rural cottages in the villages: photograph stoves, oil tanks and the fuel level, and any septic tank.
tenantHelp: Tenants can report disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions in privately rented homes to North West Leicestershire District Council's private housing team.
